subject: Portal proof sprint: temporary creds escrow + profile deltas
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena.park@globex.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: security@globex.com
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood onboarding: initial profile + SIG question

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for agreeing to help with our onboarding. We're trying to get the vendor profile live in OneTrust this week. A couple of quick asks:

- Can you confirm whether Redwood supports short-lived S3 credentials for evidence uploads? We have a staged import that needs temporary write access.
- We started to fill the SIG matrix but have a couple of clarifications on your control mappings (items in red). Can someone on your side accept a pre-filled SIG spreadsheet?

We'd like to keep the onboarding sprint tight (target: complete profile and one round of evidence by 11/27). I can attach the filled SIG as soon as you confirm the upload method.

Best,
Lena Park
Lead Vendor Risk Manager
Globex Corp
Attachments: none

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@globex.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding: initial profile + SIG question

Thanks Lena — looping in Kimberly (security intake) and Marissa (portal intake) who will coordinate the evidence handoff. Quick answers below: 

- Short-lived S3 creds: yes. We can provision per-upload temporary credentials scoped to a single prefix for a 24-hour window. We prefer pre-signed PUT for the big artifacts to avoid long-lived keys.
- SIG: please send the pre-filled SIG (xlsx) and we'll review and annotate delta rows. Marissa will ingest the spreadsheet into Vendr/OneTrust as a draft.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Lena: send the filled SIG (xlsx) and a one-line list of the S3 prefix where you'll stage artifacts.
2) Marissa: prepare a temporary upload bucket and coordinate the pre-signed URL flow with Global Ops.
3) Kimberly: list any required audit evidence we should prioritize (SOC 2 report, KMS key rotation doc, S3 ACL screenshot).

If that timeline works, we'll aim for 11/27 as Lena suggested.

- Jonas
Head of Trust Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Lena Park <lena.park@globex.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: security@globex.com
Date: Mon, 24 Nov 2025 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding: initial profile + SIG question

Jonas, thanks — attached is our filled SIG (SIG-v3-filled.xlsx) and a small screenshot of the S3 bucket ACLs we've staged (s3-permissions-screenshot.png). Our staging prefix is: globex-onboard/globex-redwood/20251124.

Notes from our side: we intentionally left a few questions in the SIG blank where the control is vendor-managed and requires your confirmation (items 12.3, 18.1). Also: we can upload evidence to your pre-signed URLs if you provide them; we cannot accept long-lived keys.

Let me know when you have a pre-signed URL and an expected upload window.

Regards,
Lena
Attachments: SIG-v3-filled.xlsx (spreadsheet), s3-permissions-screenshot.png (image)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@globex.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 Nov 2025 11:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding: temporary upload flow and profile delta ingestion

Hi Lena — thanks for the files, I'll pick this up. Implementation notes:

- I'll create a draft profile in OneTrust (ID will be shared).
- For uploads we will provide an expiring pre-signed PUT URL per artifact. Our staging service accepts up to 48 hours for large transfers — we will default to 24 hours unless you request more.
- Please upload the SIG-v3-filled.xlsx to the prefix you already created; I'll run the ingest and map any delta rows to our profile fields.
- We will not ask for long-lived credentials; the pre-signed approach matches our security posture.

Action items for Redwood team:
- Kimberly: please confirm which three evidence items we should prioritize in the first pass (I recommend SOC 2 Type II executive summary, KMS rotation notes, and the S3 ACL screenshot Lena provided).
- Ben: can you confirm whether we have any retention/archival notes to attach to the profile (we maintain artifacts for 13 months by default).

Lena — once we have the three prioritized artifacts, I'll schedule a 30-min handoff for wed 11/26 or thu 11/27 to walk the importer and confirm mapping.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Trust Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: onetrust-profile-diff.json (profile delta, for internal mapping)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lena Park <lena.park@globex.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 Nov 2025 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding: temporary upload flow and profile delta ingestion

Thanks Marissa — confirming prioritization: SOC 2 Type II executive summary (redacted OK), KMS key rotation notes (signed PDF or plaintext export), and the S3 ACL screenshot (the one Lena attached). Ben — retention default is 13 months; can we make an exception to stage the SOC 2 full report for 18 months while Globex completes procurement? If procurement needs it longer we can review.

Lena — once you upload the three items to the staging prefix, I'll do a rapid review and flag any follow-ups in the SIG spreadsheet (we'll annotate and return the file). If anything looks like an operational gap we can mark it as "control in progress" in OneTrust and document the mitigation.

I'll also add a short note in the profile about temporary credential handling (pre-signed only) so audit reviewers see the pattern.

-Kim
Security Intake Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: none
